governance.rule: 5 trustees for 5 zones; One elected trustee per zone; electors were Canadian citizens of 21 or more, able to register as provincial voters, who owned land in the district or zone (or a landowning corporation's agent, or a landowner's legal representative).
District trustees together with a Hospital Act section 5 appointee constitute the hospital board of management.
governance.locator: OIC2195/1960, added clause 5 A; cover 27 September visually checked

records.description: A hospital improvement district incorporated under the Water Act.
